description: This source file implements the CreateCVDAction component responsible for orchestrating the creation and launch of CVD (Android emulator containerized virtual device) instances, including validation, configuration, artifact retrieval, and process launching within the Android Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: BuildAPICredentials
classes.description: Holds the access token and user project ID for authentication with build APIs.

classes.name: CreateCVDActionOpts
classes.description: Configuration options for creating a CVD action.

classes.name: CreateCVDAction
classes.description: Main class responsible for orchestrating the creation and launch of CVD instances, including validation, artifact management, configuration, and process management.

methods.name: NewCreateCVDAction
methods.description: Constructor function to initialize a CreateCVDAction instance with specified options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Validates the request and host, creates necessary directories, and starts the CVD launch process asynchronously.

methods.name: launchCVD
methods.description: Handles the asynchronous launch process of a CVD instance, marking completion on success or failure.

methods.name: launchWithCanonicalConfig
methods.description: Prepares the environment configuration, creates a temp JSON file, and loads the CVD configuration into the CLI.

methods.name: launchCVDResult
methods.description: Handles the logic for launching a CVD instance based on Android CI build source, including artifact retrieval and process start.

methods.name: launchFromAndroidCI
methods.description: Launches a CVD using build artifacts from Android CI, managing parallel artifact downloads and CVD creation.

methods.name: newInstanceNumbers
methods.description: Generates sequential instance IDs for CVDs.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates the CVD creation request structure.

methods.name: createTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with specified data and permissions.
